ios.desc:
NeoBox is a Neo Geo player for Mac, iPhone, and iPad, with the emulator built in. No setup, no .ini files, no command line. Add your ROM folder and play — with save states, a real-time CRT shader, controller support, and per-game memory cards. Buy it once and it's yours on all three.

ONE APP, THREE SCREENS
The same emulator core, the same library, and the same features on every device — built natively for each, not stretched to fit. On iPhone and iPad, on-screen controls appear when you need them and step aside the moment a controller connects.

A LIBRARY THAT ORGANIZES ITSELF
Point NeoBox at a folder of MAME-format ZIPs and it scans, identifies, and organizes every cartridge it recognizes. Title, year, manufacturer, and genre come from bundled metadata, and cover art is fetched automatically — no manual tagging.

• Filter by genre, favorites, and recently played
• Instant search across your library
• On Mac: watch ROM folders for new additions, or drag in ZIPs and folders
• On iPhone and iPad: pick your ROM folder from the Files app — iCloud Drive, On My iPhone, anywhere Files can reach

EMULATION THAT JUST WORKS
NeoBox embeds a tuned Neo Geo emulator core compiled for Apple silicon. It runs the official MVS and AES catalog, including the late cartridges with custom encryption that broke other emulators.

• Timing that matches the original hardware
• Runs at the Neo Geo's own refresh rate, not a generic 60Hz
• Clean, resampled audio
• Native Metal rendering

REAL-TIME CRT SHADER
Scanlines, an RGB aperture mask, gentle curvature, and a soft vignette, rendered live. Turn it on globally or per game — or keep the picture sharp and pixel-perfect.

SAVE STATES THAT GET OUT OF YOUR WAY
On iPhone and iPad, pause and save to one of three slots per game, and pick up exactly where you left off with Continue. On Mac, F5 quicksaves and F7 loads, with numbered slots on Cmd+1–9.

PER-GAME MEMORY CARDS
Each cartridge keeps its own card — settings, high scores, and saves — just like the real hardware. See it or reset it from the game's detail screen.

CONTROLLERS AND TOUCH
Xbox, PlayStation, Switch Pro, and MFi controllers work with zero configuration; two pads give you two players. On iPhone and iPad, touch controls lay out the Neo Geo's A B C D buttons in the arcade diamond. On Mac, the keyboard works alongside any pad, and every binding can be changed.

PER-GAME SETTINGS
Every cartridge can override the defaults: system (AES or MVS), BIOS region (Japan, USA, Europe),

show_hn.title: Show HN: NeoBox – a native macOS NeoGeo emulator front end

quotes.text:
I am 90's kid. And NeGeo console was something I always longed for and only ever saw ONE person ever owning!

For those who are following...there's a new NeGeo AES console coming out later in the year!

I got excited and wanted to remember playing OG SNK games that I loved (Super Sidekicks, Metal Slug, Art of Fighting).

I first reached for the amazing OpenEmu native macOS emulator fronted, but found out it did NOT have support for NeoGeo console (FYI I later found out there is experimental support for it)

MAME is there, but wanted a nicer macOS fronted similar to Openemu.

I've built plenty of macOS / iOS in my career before (for fun and professionally). So decided to give it a shot. Soon this turned into NOT just a MAME frontend...but I wanted a NICER experience and embedded the amazing libGeoLith emulator library.

NeoBox can use either GeloLith (iwht native Metal rendering pipeline) or a frontend for a self-managed MAME installation.

So... what was AI generated and what wasn't:

* Main native macOS frontend was all hand written code, nothing fancy here. Just native AppKit code

* Painstakingly testing as many NeoGeo ROMS as possible and fixing bugs

AI-assisted:

* Website (duh ;) )

* libgeolith and Metal rendering pipeline. This truly was new terrority for me and I could NOT have done this without AI. I'm not well versed in graphics rendering pipelines so it was amazing to me how well Claude was in getting this working!

My goal...simple...hoping it funds my purchase …
